text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from
an outing with Lucky Lilac...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san. What a coincidence.
Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~, of course it's research for manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking of making the protagonist of my next work a radio DJ.
I heard there was a live public recording going on here, so I came to check it out."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, that booth over there?
I actually like radio. What's the show called?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Umm, the show's called "Uma-zing! Super Radio Ogiri",
have you heard of it, Lala-chan?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah, how should I put it?
Sounds kinda familiar, but maybe not."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Yeeep, I know all about it~~!
I was happily listenin' last week too while munchin' on rice crackers!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, they did announce a public recording...
To think I'd run into it while just hanging out...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? Wait a second.
Didn't I... on that TV show the other day...!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text: “—Alright, it's time! The Super Radio Ogiri! We'll keep reading out the witty responses sent in by our listeners this week! First up, from this listener!”

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
—Radio handle,
"La La La Big Sis"-san!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That radio name kind of sounds like Lala-chan!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, honestly. What an interesting coincidence, huh?
............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, that's meee!!
I sent that email!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa! Wait? Right now!?
Whoa-whoa-whoa, I can't help but grin!!
C'mon, give me a break~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
The prompt is—"An Umamusume won first place, but she keeps running around the track. Why?"
Here is the answer from 'La La La Sis'!

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
“I'm just a little rushed because
I want to see my darling as soon as possible♡”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Starting to come down with lovesickness, or something like that♪)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, a pun on "rushing headlong" and "falling ill"!
That was pretty cleverly put!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, ain't that the truth.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(—ALRIIIGHT!!
They love it, they love it!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, they read listener feedback on this show too, don't they...
S-So, how was it? What kind of score did I get!?)

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, "Lalala-no-Neechan"-san!
Now then, let's take a look at the comments sent in by our listeners on official Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Radio DJ
text_block_list.text:
"45 points." "The joke was a bit hard to follow." "Might be trying too hard for a clean punchline."
...Mmh. Quite a lot of harsh feedback, huh~

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? I thought it was pretty good, though~.
...Huh? Lara-chan?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, my throat's gettin' a bit dry...
I think I'll go check out the cafeteria over there."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, don't worry about me.
I'm just a little tired, that's all... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was so fun~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your interview
went pretty well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like the storyboarding is gonna go super fast!
Plus, your answers for the comedy improv were so creative—it was really inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really loved that answer in particular! The one playing on "rushing ahead"! It was so witty and full of emotion!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hope that creator keeps trying and does their best!
I get down sometimes too when people leave harsh comments on my manga, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you find something interesting,
I think you should keep putting it out there!
Because someday, it'll definitely strike a chord with someone!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-san...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...That actually hits home more than I thought.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Rather than harsh comments from a bunch of strangers, the thoughts of the one person standing right in front of me...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Geez. When ya say nice things like that,
how'm I supposed to stay down in the dumps?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Then next time, let's bring the house down! On my honor as radio listener, "La-La-La Big Sis"!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure we'll get to hear it again.
The 'La La La Sis' comedy routine, I mean."
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it too—her new oogiri routine!
I'm looking forward to it too, her new comedic banter!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure we'll get to hear it again.
The 'La La La Sis' comedy routine, I mean."
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it too—her new oogiri routine!
I'm looking forward to it too, her new comedic banter!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Lala-chan's Trainer took a liking to it too.
'Lalala Big Sis'-san.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, should we start
a fan club or something ourselves?
choice_data_list: Oh, that might be a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No, no waaaay!!
If you make something like that, it'll blow up!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Could it be because... I received
such wonderful, miraculous words from you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ? Lala-chan, is that a comedy bit?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows?
...Fufu♪
